Grinding for experience and gold is essential, with rewards that go beyond mere survival—upgrading equipment, learning new, provocative skills, and indulging in the city's dark temptations.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/71e33f42f7c2853f8fec612b7d299d4b8d885207.png[/img]

notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3141990/The_Succubus_Queen_and_the_Holy_Sword/

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/d69bdca66aae1508c019a5e31fc9177afdd2b7c0.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/fe20325a0a1b95eaf66957bdd0cb5a2f305abb51.png[/img]
Behold, thirsty adventurers! Immerse yourself in a do-or-die mission where the fate of a princess and her girlfriend is at stake.

As Elara, the busty dark elf princess of Eldoria, you must storm the castle of Lilith, the succubus queen, who holds her beloved Seraphina captive.

Can you overcome strategic battles against the queen's horde of seductive Rubenesque succubi?

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/d1c1a7b097c1497500fb15f0701ea2bd6f8c5d10.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/7acb51d8aca58a70f9805fda51b1772a8484c80a.png[/img]
• Experience an intense boss-rush dungeon crawler RPG where every encounter is a battle of wits, strategy, and persistence.
• Experience a thrilling adventure that respects your time and presents a challenge solely in the final dungeon.
• Experience the thrill of classic gaming with Game Boy Color-style sounds and visuals that bring nostalgia in a new and whimsical way.
• Prepare to face 40+ lady demons with unique powers and strategies, who will push your patience to the limit and destroy you unless you out-fight them.
• In intense party-based battles, strategy is crucial, and building an arsenal is essential for dealing with intense threats in innovative ways.
• Explore the grand, sprawling, and perilous Castle of the Succubus Queen, exploring its labyrinthine corridors and uncovering numerous secrets.
• Customize your party by uncovering equipment and stat-boosting items in the Succubus Queen's castle compounds, making wise choices to enhance their abilities or boost their potential.
• Enhance your party's build with "Soul Fragments," inspired by the Paper Mario duology's badges.
• Experience a thrilling mission centered on strategic boss fights, eliminating tedious level grinding and mindless random battles.

notes.title: Book of Korvald OUT NOW!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2132380/Book_of_Korvald/

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/23168fc4cd830526adb12d799beadc2bc4561bf3.png[/img]

[b]Book of Korvald is OUT NOW on Steam! [/b]Book of Korvald tells the saga of a Norse scribe, and his alliance with a parasitic eldritch entity. Join forces with beautiful warrior nuns, sexy mythical figures and lustful interdimensional creatures to prevent our world from being devoured. Can you contain your sexual urges and fight to survive? 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/d3c80a887ca8238abdab5c93b2d5b5898a832691.png[/img]

Book of Korvald tells the saga of a Norse scribe, and his alliance with an eldritch entity named "Qhroth'un".

History does not tell us that Norse clans had scribes of their own. Their folklore is said to have been preserved through oral traditions exclusively, but this is not the truth. Many written sagas were damaging to the reputation of royal families and expository to the church. So these writings, along with their authors, were aggressively purged from existence. Korvald was one such scribe.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/15b48123089c8e96badd36a288b47601ddd51a32.png[/img]
Korvald's is not a tale of heroism and justice, but of deceit and suffering provoked by powerful religious empires and unseen cosmic forces. His story begins as so many are ended. Family slain and taken from his now destroyed village, Korvald is branded as a heretic and seemingly condemned to death. The true purpose of his capture and torment are part of a much bigger and far more sinister agenda. In his darkest hour, Korvald is approached by Qhroth'un and an agreement is made that will change everything...
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/34357d04c1a657d9fa8a369dea66d188a6eb5296.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/b86b29fe922ffe18811ada8f7d7ccd48f640e7ac.png[/img]
- Over 50 different female characters complete with sexual encounters. All raw, hot and fully animated.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/38fd4b2ffa2893f6a86a66601d87132087cb5223.gif[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/08699a9b705e37b3c59df293d8faf0e5f919c4cd.png[/img]

[b]Maps / Environments / Areas:[/b]
- Each chapter takes place across an entire country, spanning over 30 areas. Starting in Denmark near the city of Ribe, drawing inspiration from the conversion to Christianity that took place around the 9th century in Scandinavia.

[b]Weapons:[/b]
- 200+ different weapons to find or buy from various shops. Axes, Swords, Maces, Whips, Spears, Flails, Daggers, Shields, and Books (yes books).

[b]Artifacts:[/b]
- 30+ different artifacts and special off-hand weapons to equip. You could raise the dead Templar knights as zombie minions, inflict plagues on nearby enemies, and even cause certain NPCs (and even some enemies) to strip naked (because... why not?).

[b]Runes:[/b]
- Korvald will discover the true meaning and origin of runes and runestones. Utilizing his unique insight into this powerful language, he will gain the ability to harness many destructive and helpful forces. Unleash flaming cyclones, lightning storms, arctic blizzards, healing waters and even summon eldritch creatures to aid you in combat.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/64388e27ba7f7491195e40dbedc0a6e1437ced41.png[/img]

Inspired by Monster Girl's Labyrinth, Dungeon Vixens is a dungeon crawling rouge-like monster girl adventure with retro graphics. You play as a lone protagonist with a quest to reclaim his love.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/b53858c91d70e17e5759670a1b0044439e585b4a.gif[/img]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/1a7bc1335ef4b60cfd30f1b75f72a9d4edf797dd.png[/img]

The dungeon he is about to enter however is filled with a lot of temptations and challenges. Such as the Succubus Lilura and many other sexy vixens that roam the halls. Using your attack and defense slider system timing is everything.

Will you mend your heart or be lost forever in a Vixen filled dungeon of lust and pleasure?

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/863d8f288f8f612547f52fabba8bd8acf6f59dfe.png[/img]

- Mysterious and intricate labyrinth setting, filled with hidden secrets and challenges.
- 18 Challenging Levels with over 90 minutes of gameplay and even more to obtain all treasures of the dungeon.
- Over 20 monster girls each with their own styles and sex scenes!
- Many challenges and secrets buried within the tunnels to discover!
- Minigames within the walls of the dungeon: Slot Machines & other interactive elements.
- Multiple Endings depending on the players choices including a SECRET ending.
- 5 Trading Cards & 6 Achievments!
